results.title: Trial Period
results.overview: Polina is a glamorous businessman’s daughter accustomed to a carefree life. After her father’s betrayal, she ends up on probation at an advertising agency. There, over the course of a month, she competes for a position with Roman — an ambitious and principled colleague who sees the world very differently. Their professional rivalry gradually transforms into conflicts, unexpected closeness, and situations where it becomes difficult to separate work tasks from personal feelings.

results.title: Mala
results.overview: Reema inherits an abandoned resort on a remote island, and with her three friends, sets out to uncover the truth behind her inheritance. She soon discovers strange locals, cryptic messages from her late mother, and a familial curse involving tantric rituals and black magic. As tensions rise, Reema and her friends must confront their deepest fears to survive the island’s sinister grip.

results.title: Stardom All Star Grand Queendom 2026
results.original_title: ミツカン フルーティス presents ALL STAR GRAND QUEENDOM 2026
results.overview: All Star Grand Queendom 2026 was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom. It was held on April 26, 2026 at Yokohama Arena in Yokohama, Kanagawa, Japan, and is the fourth event in the Grand Queendom chronology. In the main event, Saya Kamitami defended the World of Stardom Championship against Sayaka Kurara, who was forced to risk the future of Cosmic Angels in an attempt to topple the Phenix Queen.  Other featured matches included a Wonder of Stardom Championship match between champion Konami and 2026 Cinderella Tournament winner Hanan, 02line (AZM and Miyu Amasaki) challenging BMI2000 (Natsuko Tora and Ruaka) for the the Goddesses of Stardom Championship after a controversial prior defense in January, and Natsupoi and Maki Itoh in a kawaii-based grudge match. A retirement ceremony for long-time star Saki Kashima was also held.

results.title: Happy Journey
results.overview: A group of seven women across generations set off on a spontaneous European getaway, leaving their everyday lives behind. Amid the chaos, laughter and picturesque landscapes, the journey becomes an unexpected celebration of freedom and friendship.

results.title: Selvi
results.overview: After her best friend Kavitha’s sudden collapse, Selvi, a home care nurse, takes on her shifts in addition to her own, determined to hold everything together. Moving from one house to another, she spends her days caring for the elderly, rarely stopping to rest. As the long hours blur the boundaries between care and exhaustion, Selvi begins to confront the weight of guilt, love, and survival.

results.title: The Serpent's Skin
results.overview: Two young women form a romantic bond after discovering they have supernatural powers. Their insecurities unknowingly release a demon, which possesses one of their exes and begins feeding on their friends. As the bodies pile up, it becomes up to the women to face their pasts and stop the growing evil.

results.title: Blood Totem
results.overview: The world of the supernatural meets the wild west when a small group of solders enter Apache county to find their missing comrade. Quickly, they discover something is terribly wrong as the very land itself appears to have turned against them. As they face demons of both man and myth, it's going to take all they have to survive.

results.title: Black Zombie
results.overview: From the flickering screens of Hollywood horror, to the haunted cane fields of colonial Haiti, Black Zombie unearths the buried origins of the zombie, reclaiming it as a symbol of survival and spiritual resistance.

results.title: DeSu7
results.overview: After years apart, two people reunite for a fresh start. A story of deep emotion, romance, and action about love that endures and a reunion destined to happen.

results.title: Ada
results.overview: Two sisters on a forgotten island, surrounded by a sea full of rubbish. They are waiting for Darko, the island's keeper: he brings food and is their last link to the world. Silence is their survival strategy. But on an island without rules, silence too comes at a price.
